description: I’m Vivek, a B.Tech CSE (Data Science) student and freelance full-stack developer (React, Node, Gemini API) with a passion for physics and quantum mechanics. I'm leading 'Team Solar system' to tackle the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge by building an AI-powered interactive 3D map using NASA datasets. I'm looking for creative UI/UX designers, 3D graphics developers (like Three.js), and space data enthusiasts to round out the team. Let's build an award-winning app together!
